title: Jaren model document
description: A jaren-model document declares the collections of a store: each collection is a JSON Schema for its documents, a key declaration (an RFC 6901 pointer for caller-supplied keys, or null with a declared identity for store-allocated ones), and the indexes over singular JSONPath expressions. This is the 0.1 subset, where every collection is an entity with no relations and a single JSON document column; later vocabulary is added to THIS format, never as a second format.

collections.description: Collection name (an identifier) to collection declaration.

collection.description: One collection: a document schema, the key declaration, and the declared indexes. A collection without a key pointer MUST declare how keys are allocated; allocation is declared, never guessed.

schema.description: The JSON Schema every stored document validates against (through the injected hook). Also the type source for indexed paths.

key.description: Where the caller-supplied key lives in the document, as an RFC 6901 pointer selecting at least one member — or null when the store allocates.

identity.description: How keys come to be: 'caller' (the default when a key pointer is declared), or — only with "key": null — 'uuid' (crypto.randomUUID) or 'integer' (database-allocated).

indexes.description: Declared indexes; each singular path becomes a generated column plus an index.

x-rename.description: Migration hint: this collection was previously named the given identifier. Read by the migration planner (a rename cannot be inferred from a diff); ignored by the store.

index.description: One index over a singular JSONPath expression (or a composite over several). A non-singular path is rejected at open (JD0004).

name.description: The index name, unique within its collection.

path.description: A singular JSONPath expression into the stored document ($.email), or a non-empty array of them for a composite index.

unique.description: Whether the index enforces uniqueness. Defaults to false.
